newsitem.title: USA: No contract talks scheduled at Alcoa plant.
newsitem.headline: No contract talks scheduled at Alcoa plant.

text.p: No contract talks are scheduled between Aluminum Co of America and the United Autoworkers union in the midst of a strike at the company's Cleveland forging plant, company spokeswoman Joyce Saltzman said Monday.
Employees of UAW Local 1050 struck the plant on September 4 when their former three-year contract expired. Negotiations between the company and union had failed to produce a new agreement.

The plant employs approximately 1,100 union members. The company restarted "selected production centers" in the plant using salaried employees, Saltzman said. She said 350 salaried employees are working at the plant.
Alcoa's Cleveland operation produces forged aluminum parts for several industries including aerospace and automotive.
